review.assessment: The change introduces a new implementation of deepClone that performs only shallow copying by spreading object properties and mapping array elements without recursion. This code fails to meet the requirement of fully independent copies, as nested objects and arrays remain shared references with the original data structure.

findings.actual: The cloned inner objects/arrays are modified alongside the original because they are the same reference.
findings.call: const orig = { a: { b: 1 } }; const clone = deepClone(orig); (clone as any).a.b = 2; console.log(orig.a.b === 1) // prints false
findings.defect: Nested objects are not deep cloned.
findings.expected: The original object should remain unmodified after mutating the cloned nested properties.

findings.actual: Elements inside cloned arrays point to the same references as in the original array.
findings.call: const orig = [{ x: 1 }]; const clone = deepClone(orig); (clone[0] as any).x = 2; console.log(orig[0].x === 1) // prints false
findings.defect: Nested arrays and their element references are not deep cloned.
findings.expected: The original array content should remain unmodified after mutating elements of the cloned array.
